review14_finding.evidence: §93 now requires malformed catalog format rejection only; no catalog HMAC assertion remains.

findings.title: Path-open SQLite connection is not demonstrably bound to OpenVerified file handle
findings.evidence: SQLite opens a canonical path, then a hook compares PRAGMA database_list path and OS file ID. The spec does not establish that this ID comes from SQLite's opened OS file object; path stat can describe a different current directory entry. The test also demands the replaced DB is never accessed, although the driver may open/read it before the hook.
findings.required_change: Use a VFS that consumes the verified handle and exposes the open object's identity, or narrow the guarantee to rejection before application SQL/receipt query and specify the exact observable race test.

findings.title: Catalog file-ID expectation is not defined across required atomic replacement
findings.evidence: The catalog must atomically replace its file and fail closed on file-ID changes, but the expected identity anchor and legitimate update/restart rule are unspecified. The test cannot distinguish the expected replacement inode from unauthorized substitution.
findings.required_change: Specify how expected catalog identity is durably anchored/updated across atomic replacement and restart; test an allowed replacement and an unauthorized replacement, with only the latter global-failing before any case DB open.
